title: GlobalFoundries says the US plans to award it $300M in CHIPS Act funding to bolster R&D of silicon photonics tech to power more efficient AI data centers (Reuters)
summary: Reuters: GlobalFoundries says the US plans to award it $300M in CHIPS Act funding to bolster R&D of silicon photonics tech to power more efficient AI data centers — GlobalFoundries (GFS.O) said on Wednesday the U.S. government will award $300 million to the chipmaker to bolster research …
